test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following dance forms of Nagaland is performed as preparation for a hunting expedition?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sadal Kekai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sadal Kekai dance is performed by the Kuki tribe.**
 
• This dance form of Nagaland is performed as preparation for a hunting expedition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Important dance forms of different tribes:**
 
• **Aaluyattu**:
 
 
• This dance is performed by the Konyak tribe.
 
 
 
• **Agurshikukula**:
 
 
• This is a war dance.
 
 
 
• **Butterfly Dance:**
 
 
• This dance is performed by the Zeliang tribe
 
 
 
• **Changai Dance:**
 
 
• This dance is performed by the Changs.
 
 
 
• **Khamba Lim:**
 
 
• It is performed by two groups of men and women who stand in two rows. A similar dance is known as the Akhu.
 
 
 
• **Kuki Dance:**
 
 
• It is performed by the Nagas using bamboo sticks.
 
 
 
• **Leshalaptu**:
 
 
• This dance is performed by women.
 
 
 
• **Mayur Dance:**
 
 
• It is an animal dance.
 
 
 
• **Modse**:
 
 
• This dance is performed by the Ao tribe.
 
 
 
• **Monyoasho:**
 
 
• It is another dance form of Nagaland.
 
 
 
• **Seecha & Kukui Kucho:**
 
 
• These dances are performed by the Angami tribe.
 
 
 
• **Shankai & Moyashai:**
 
 
• It is a victory dance performed by the Lotha tribe.
 
 
 
• **Rengma**:
 
 
• This dance is performed by the Rengma tribe, especially during the Ngada festival.
